description: A fictional stylised low-poly video-game prop in the shape of a big long rifle on two thin legs, a chunky toy-like cartoon 3D game asset (not a real object, no working parts). A long boxy dark grey main body block with a flat lid on top carrying a short ridged strip and a small boxy block with a round hoop at its back end. A long heavy round dark grey tube sticking out of the front, with a matte black ribbed carry bar on two small brackets above it near the main body, a triangular frame standing on it near the front end, and a chunky slotted cylinder at the very front end. Under the rear half of the tube a matte black front cover with four oblong slots along its side. Under the main body a matte black handle raked backward with a small curved dark grey lever inside a rounded loop. Hanging under the main body in front of the handle a big squarish matte black box with a chamfered bottom and a bright orange band round its top edge. At the rear a solid matte black shoulder piece with a hooked lower edge and a flat end plate. Under the tube in front of the cover two thin dark grey legs angled down and slightly forward, splayed left and right like an upside-down V, each ending in a small flat orange foot. Bright orange accents: the band round the top edge of the box, a small knob on the left flank of the main body, and the two feet. On the left flank of the main body, above the box, a short vertical row of five small brass-yellow pegs with dark pointed tips. The right flank is plain.
proportions: About 1.10 m long, 0.12 m wide and 0.30 m tall. (length : width : height = 9.17 : 1 : 2.50)
sides: the small orange knob and the short row of brass-yellow pegs are on the left flank of the main body, above the box; the right flank is plain; everything else (the two legs, the box, the carry bar) is symmetric left to right.
